activity.notes: Maria Theresa was Archduchess of Austria from her succession in 1740 until her death in 1780. ATLAS records the Austrian archducal crown separately from the Hungarian and Bohemian crowns.

sources.title: Maria Theresa — Die Welt der Habsburger
sources.citation_text: The Habsburg history portal identifies Maria Theresa as ruler of the Habsburg Monarchy from 1740 to 1780, Queen of Hungary and Bohemia, and Archduchess of Austria.

sources.title: Maria Theresia (1717–1780) — Naturhistorisches Museum Wien
sources.citation_text: The Natural History Museum Vienna identifies Maria Theresa as sovereign of the Habsburg territories and Archduchess of Austria from 1740 to 1780.
